description: This Java source file defines the class JsonValueFieldDefinition, which is a specialized implementation of JsonFieldDefinition for handling JsonValue types. It provides methods for creating instances with type safety and for converting JsonValue objects into Java types, primarily used for parsing JSON objects in a type-safe manner within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: JsonValueFieldDefinition
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractJsonFieldDefinition, tailored for JsonValue types, providing factory methods to create type-safe JSON field definitions and convert JsonValues to Java types.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new JsonValueFieldDefinition instance with specified pointer, value type, check function, mapping function, and optional markers.

methods.name: getAsJavaType
methods.description: Overrides the method to convert a JsonValue to a Java type using the provided mapping function.
